title: They Both Die at the End
author: Adam Silvera
summary: In a world where a service calls you on the day you will die, two teenage strangers, Mateo and Rufus, meet through an app. They set out to make the most of their last twenty-four hours together.
readIf: you want a moving story that makes you think about what you would do with your final day.
skipIf: you dislike sad stories, because the title is a promise.

pairings.reason: Another teen story where mortality shapes everything, written with humour and heart.
A gentler, more hopeful story of two boys and an honest, tender friendship.
Another novel that asks how to live well when time is limited.
